verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS platform like LaunchDarkly, which collects context attributes, evaluation events, session replays and AI Run data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of retention settings, deletion requests, or purge controls. Expiring individual flag targeting and FedRAMP compliance are different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
